text: hey so uh i have a questioin and i have a suggestion, both related to the same and the question could entirely remove the need for the suggestion because it would just change the shape of it but anyways so im not entirely sure how they work, but when it comes to flora, the actual rendered thing, does that come from a 'plane' (maybe its not called this, but the concept ) or how does it come? like, uh grass blades. is this just a plane that is the blade or ? the reason i ask is only because the current approach, while i am a huge fan of the outcome of it as it stands right now, (it genuinely looks great) my ability to write the code to expand on this myself is effectively 0, while my ability to manipulate and texture meshes though is steadily growing, so where do we, if possible, get the ability to export an authored something from the studio, and have it bake into the same likeness of flora today? and then the suggestion is that, the current approach has methods where there are 'sparse' 'dense' of the same flora, but this is kinda just stupid if u ask me, why cant it just be a density slider at paint time when im authoring? and i have to assume a lot of this falls right into the how it even works at all whichim hoping to get the answer i want out of all of this but il take a slap in the face also

events.text: Answered in full: (1) flora IS planes — GrassBlade.ts = 3 crossed quads, shader paints wisps/gradient/wind; trees = one baked <=512-vert card mesh per species (flora_geometry.zig); field = deterministic formula (foliage.zig bladeRow) expanding cell indices into slim instances of ONE shared mesh. (2) Authored studio flora is architecturally ready — same 8-float vertex format, wrapped-species path already renders shared-mesh+instances; missing piece is the registration bridge (authored model -> flora species entry + legend + loader key resolve). (3) Confirmed sparse/dense are just table rows (count 3/7/16, chance .08/.22/.7); recommended species+quantized-density packed per cell, RLE-friendly, replacing the variant entries.

resolution: Question+suggestion req: answered how flora renders (crossed-quad cards + shader, one shared mesh per species, deterministic per-cell expansion from painted indices), assessed the authored-flora export path as feasible (same vertex format, wrapped-species instancing already fits; needs a registration bridge from studio export to the flora catalog/legend/loader), and endorsed the density-slider suggestion with a concrete shape: collapse sparse/med/dense variant rows into one species entry plus a quantized density level packed into the per-cell small int, keeping RLE-friendly wire format. No code changed — this was an ask; implementation awaits the user's go.
